DRUG REHAB FRAUDSTER: One Armed Bandit

By: Michael Duffett | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
sinking to new levels - fraudulent drug rehab committal orders

Unique Selling Point:
An ex so called reformed drug addict has an intervention squad, and is using fake arrest or rehabilitation committal orders to haul off addicts to treatment centre, by passing the courts..and fleecing desperate parents of addicts who don't know the law. He has been doing this for some time now and despite the police knowing about this man, they have not arrested him.

Summary:
The law provides relief for parents or spouses of addicts who refuse treatment. A rehab enquiry takes place and either a state social worker or a private social worker is part of the process. The complainant needs to write out a detailed affidavit re the circumstances of the addict. Then a social worker investigates.... and a magistrate can issue an arrest warrant against the respondent - the addict - if he/she refuses to come to court> Because committal orders are quite draconian - a minimum of a year in a centre - the respondent always has to face a magistrate for an enquiry.

Enter Jacques Peterson, a reformed addict . though that is doubtful - he preys on the desperate parents who don't know the law. For a fee of up to R8000, he gets complainants to write out a complaint and send to him. Parents then have to deposit the money into his account, and hey ho, the next day he arrives with a committal order or an arrest warrant and he in effect kidnaps the addicts and carts then off to rehab centre - there are 3 centres he takes them to. Besides the orders being fake, if an arrest is made, a police man has to be present. I have no doubt that the centres know about this man and we will need to confront them as well.

Further information:
He was bust by Frikkie Heefer who runs a legit rehab centre in Potch. Frikkie himself has an interesting back story - but too was on drugs, but 12 years ago became abstinent. He does run a really good rehab centre. He found that 8 rehab orders were fake. He had to inform the addicts that they were fake and some left his centre. He confronted Jacques who confessed his ways, promising to pay back those he frauded. He has paid back just two. He begged Frikkie not to report him to the police. He could not go back to prison.. and he would lose everything. Jacques also implicated a social worker at the Randburg court Elizabeth Elizabeth Malaza who told him that she would make sure that neither the respondent and complainant had to come to court.

The issue is that he seems to be still doing this. Just last month it happened again. There are stories that he is also doing drugs on the way to the rehab centres. There are some disturbing stories that a trip that should take an hour takes four hours with a drugged up addict lying semi conscious in his car. He has hurt people when arresting them, he hand cuffs them, and also pounces at night, which is deeply frowned upon when doing legitimate removals. Plenty of people will talk to us, and we need to set up a sting. . We are dealing with a woman called Debbie who works at a rehab centre. She has asked for a day or two to think how she can set up a sting. Failing that she will provide his home address details for us to do a confront. I somehow don't think phoning him for an interview or sending questions will have any impact. My sense is that when confronted, he will "sing".

Tomorrow Tony Beamish will ascertain that the officials who are on the arrest/committal orders don't work at the Randburg Court.
I shall also in Cape Town interview a top private social worker who is involved in rehab committal processes - to have that interview as a back up.

Extra Budget Items:
flight to JHB and back - will stay at Tony Beamish to reduce costs. 2 days car hire.

Press Release:


Drug Rehab Scamster
Preying on the desperation of parents who don’t know the laws around having their drug addicted children admitted to rehabilitation facilities, we investigate a man who is swindling families out of thousands of Rands when they are already at their lowest ebb. A reformed drug addict, this conman now works under the banner of “Drug Squad” – but Carte Blanche shows that his arrests are fake, his court orders are phony and he may well be guilty of kidnapping, after forcibly taking addicts from their homes.
Producer: Michael Duffett
Presenter: Masa Kekana


Script:


At 11pm, on the the 12th of June last year, Kate, not her real name, who suffered a serious prescription drug problem was preparing a bath. Suddenly a stranger emerged from the shadows.

.Kate: He told me that he had a warrant and that I either go to the rehab or go to jail.

She says that she was handcuffed in front of her young son, and whilst still in her pyjamas, was forced into a vehicle and driven way at high speed.

Less than a week later Monique le Riche who was also addicted to drugs, had just been admitted to hospital where she was confronted by a man she thought was a policeman.

Le Riche: He said that if I don’t come with him he will cuff me in front of everybody in the hospital.

Both women were taken to rehabilitation centres far from home.


LINK

It seems inconceivable that there is a man who is operating in Gauteng under the name of drug squad who is illegally abducting addicts and driving them to rehab centers.

That man is Jacques Peterson

Up sound- I am 40 years old, I was an addict for 23 years. Hooked on coke and crack.


After becoming drug free, Peterson set himself up to intervene on behalf of parents of drug addicts

His fee is dependent on the geographical location of the addict and in some cases can be in excess of R12 000.

On his Facebook page, he makes reference to a law which can assist families of loved ones, who are in the grip of addiction, and refuse to go for treatment.

LINK
Its called the prevention and treatment of substance abuse act…and it provides for involuntarily committals.

The act allows a magistrate to send an addict to a treatment centres.. There is no cost if a state social worker in involved. A private social worker, like Tracy Help, an addiction specialist, will charge a fee. She will meet with an addict’s family and after an investigation, a date will be set for a hearing.

Tracy: if the person will not appear in court, or we believe that if they are made aware of the order or they will run away or harm themselves or others then we may chose to then the court for a warrant.

That warrant must be executed by a police officer who will make sure that the addict appears before the magistrate. The addict is entitled to representation and to cross examine witnesses.

Those rights were never extended to Kate, who chose not to reveal her identity for fear of victimization. Her husband committed suicide in front of her and this traumatic event left her unable to cope

Kate – a doctor prescribed me sleeping tablets and anti depressants so I could try and not remember...one became two, two became three, eventually I was taking 30 a night.

Her mother paid Peterson to intervene but had no idea of his methods. Being handcuffed, which Peterson denies, re - traumatized her to such an extent that she was unable to engage in treatment for weeks.

Monique Le Richie was also traumatized by Peterson’s extra- judicial style of intervention.. She suffered a serious crystal
meth-am-phet-a-mine addiction

Interview: I very quickly lost everything and found myself on the streets. Hassling for money for drugs.

After one stint in a rehab center, she managed to live drug free but then she relapsed. Unable to manage her addiction and her job, she became severely depressed.

INTERVIEW I had already googled how to make a noose and everything like that, so that day I just had enough at work I had a scarf with me. I made a make shift noose and I went to the bathroom and I tried to hang myself.

Masa: what happened after that?

Half way through I realized that I did not want to die, so kicked against the wall and one of my colleagues heard.

A colleague saved her and she was rushed to hospital. Even before she was assessed by a doctor …Peterson arrived and apprehended her.

presenter: did he have any papers?
le riche: no

Without any legitimate documents she was taken to a faith based rehabilitation center called HOPE AGAIN just outside Potchefstroom. The owner Frikkie Heefer had already become suspicious of Peterson …. firstly, court orders supplied by him had all emanated from the Randburg Magistrates court . 2ndly, Heefer and his team had recently managed to get a court order from a Pretoria magistrate for a patient they feared would abscond.

Heefer: This court order was just copied and pasted for about I don’t know how many people. Spelling mistakes, wrong id numbers We confronted him, he said that he was very sorry and he was crying and he would pay back the money.

In that email Peterson wrote - ‘ I only tried to help family’s because I have been to numerous courts, where the magistrate doesn’t even give the order and then the families lose the money that they paid the social worker. Peterson would be referring to social workers in private practice.

He also begged for mercy and not to be sent to jail.

HEEFER showed Petersons documents to the Randburg Magistrates Court who then advised him to lay charges at the Potchestroom police station.

Heefer :We have been to the police station many times, we get no feedback….l

We took 4 OF PETERSON’S court orders and arrest warrants to the Ransburg Magistrates court and showed senior prosecutor Yusuf Baba who provided 6 reasons as to why they were all fake. For example, the name of the magistrate on the court orders….

Baba: This magistrate does not work at Randburg so long as I have been at Randburg 2013.
Presenter: But they are all on these forms?
Baba: But he does not work here.

Baba: I have investigated and can say that all of these people never appeared here – because the date stamp, this stamp is fraudulent. i

On the left is what the date stamp should look like, the one on the right is the stamp appearing on Peterson’s documents.

It was time to confront him. We located his address and were about to call him to request an interview when we spotted him leaving the complex.

Presenter: But are you not using fake documents to transport addicts to rehab centers. And then charging these parents 1000’s of Rand

Peterson: No no

Presenter: Then what are you doing?

Petersion: I am not going to talk to you in front of the camera like this, I will talk to you privately.

Peterson said he would speak to us later. We arranged a sit down interview for later in the week.

We then contacted 5 other rehabilitation centers who told us that they had all cut ties with Peterson because of complaints leveled against him.

We then set up our cameras for our sit down interview…..

Link

Well its already 2.30. Jacque had agreed to meet with us us at 2 pm.. he is not here yet…. but we will wait.

He didn’t pitch. Another date was set but that also never materialized. We then sent him allegations to which he responded by voice note, and was surprisingly honest about court documents he had supplied.

Peterson: yes, some of them were fake…and the reason is that sometimes parents are in such state, they need help immediately and a court order can take months.

That doesn’t cut it with Tracy Help who does understand the plight of loved ones of addicts.

Tracy: A court order is not an emergency intervention. The addiction has taken a long time to get to where it is at…and if we can do an order properly…and hold the person in the right treatment center, they stand the best chance of recovery.

And that had been Heefer’s experience.
Or
Heefer couldn’t agree more…

Presenter: At the time you had people here who you were taking care of.. who he had brought in, what happened to those people?

Heefer: Some of them left…..
Presenter: because they never had to be here?
Heefer: yes

In the meantime, Monique chose to remain in treatment- despite no valid court order and the illegal method of her removal from the hospital

Presenter: how you doing Monique?
Monique: Very well now, I am clean for 1.5 years, I work here actually.
Presenter: Congrats!
Monique: Thanks

Kate also remained in treatment and is doing well but she is still upset at the way she was treated.

Kate: I am still angry, I don’t think its something you just get over – it should not have happened – I should not have experienced that, nor should of my son!


Peterson says that he has paid back most of the parents, though we spoke to several who said he that he had not. He also said that he was paid a commission fee by rehabilitation centers. However, he could be in serious trouble and face several charges which include fraud and even kidnapping.

Baba: if I was the prosecutor dealing with this matter, I would seek jail time because you have violated the constitutional rights of a person, their liberty, with fraudulent documentation, also you have put the criminal justice system into disrepute, and further he has taken money from innocent people for his own selfish gain.

Baba: if I was the prosecutor dealing with this matter, I would seek jail time because you have violated the constitutional rights of a person, their liberty, with fraudulent documentation, also you have put the criminal justice system into disrepute, and further he has taken money from innocent people for his own selfish gain. metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): sinking to new levels - fraudulent drug rehab committal orders
metadata.Unique Selling Point: An ex so called reformed drug addict has an intervention squad, and is using fake arrest or rehabilitation committal orders to haul off addicts to treatment centre, by passing the courts..and fleecing desperate parents of addicts who don't know the law. He has been doing this for some time now and despite the police knowing about this man, they have not arrested him.
metadata.Summary: The law provides relief for parents or spouses of addicts who refuse treatment. A rehab enquiry takes place and either a state social worker or a private social worker is part of the process. The complainant needs to write out a detailed affidavit re the circumstances of the addict. Then a social worker investigates.... and a magistrate can issue an arrest warrant against the respondent - the addict - if he/she refuses to come to court> Because committal orders are quite draconian - a minimum of a year in a centre - the respondent always has to face a magistrate for an enquiry. Enter Jacques Peterson, a reformed addict . though that is doubtful - he preys on the desperate parents who don't know the law. For a fee of up to R8000, he gets complainants to write out a complaint and send to him. Parents then have to deposit the money into his account, and hey ho, the next day he arrives with a committal order or an arrest warrant and he in effect kidnaps the addicts and carts then off to rehab centre - there are 3 centres he takes them to. Besides the orders being fake, if an arrest is made, a police man has to be present. I have no doubt that the centres know about this man and we will need to confront them as well.
metadata.Further information: He was bust by Frikkie Heefer who runs a legit rehab centre in Potch. Frikkie himself has an interesting back story - but too was on drugs, but 12 years ago became abstinent. He does run a really good rehab centre. He found that 8 rehab orders were fake. He had to inform the addicts that they were fake and some left his centre. He confronted Jacques who confessed his ways, promising to pay back those he frauded. He has paid back just two. He begged Frikkie not to report him to the police. He could not go back to prison.. and he would lose everything. Jacques also implicated a social worker at the Randburg court Elizabeth Elizabeth Malaza who told him that she would make sure that neither the respondent and complainant had to come to court. The issue is that he seems to be still doing this. Just last month it happened again. There are stories that he is also doing drugs on the way to the rehab centres. There are some disturbing stories that a trip that should take an hour takes four hours with a drugged up addict lying semi conscious in his car. He has hurt people when arresting them, he hand cuffs them, and also pounces at night, which is deeply frowned upon when doing legitimate removals. Plenty of people will talk to us, and we need to set up a sting. . We are dealing with a woman called Debbie who works at a rehab centre. She has asked for a day or two to think how she can set up a sting. Failing that she will provide his home address details for us to do a confront. I somehow don't think phoning him for an interview or sending questions will have any impact. My sense is that when confronted, he will "sing". Tomorrow Tony Beamish will ascertain that the officials who are on the arrest/committal orders don't work at the Randburg Court. I shall also in Cape Town interview a top private social worker who is involved in rehab committal processes - to have that interview as a back up.
